title: AAT Accounts Assistant
description:
AAT Accounts Assistant

Robert Half are delighted to be partnering with an innovative and growing technology business based in Cardiff to recruit an AAT Accounts Assistant.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious finance professional looking to join a forward-thinking organisation that can offer genuine career progression, exposure to a broad range of finance responsibilities, and ongoing AAT study support. The successful candidate will become a key member of the finance team and play an important role in supporting the day-to-day accounting function while developing their career within the business.

Key Responsibilities
- Supporting the production of monthly management accounts.
- Managing accounts payable and accounts receivable processes.
- Performing bank, supplier, and balance sheet reconciliations.
- Assisting with month-end and year-end close activities.
- Processing journals, accruals, and prepayments.
- Monitoring cash flow and supporting cash management activities.
- Investigating and resolving financial queries.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring data integrity.
- Assisting with financial reporting and analysis.
- Supporting process improvements and finance transformation initiatives.

About the Candidate

The ideal candidate will have:
- AAT qualification or be actively studying towards completion.
- Previous experience within an Accounts Assistant, Assistant Accountant, or similar finance role.
- Strong understanding of core accounting principles.
- Good Excel skills and confidence working with financial systems.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
- A proactive approach with a willingness to learn and develop.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across the business.

What's on Offer?
- AAT study support and ongoing professional development.
- Clear progression opportunities within a growing finance team.
- Exposure to a broad range of accounting responsibilities.
- Opportunity to work for an innovative technology company.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Modern Cardiff office location with excellent transport links.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.

This role would suit an ambitious finance professional who is looking to build on their existing experience while continuing their studies and progressing towards a more senior accounting position in the future.

title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Accounts Administrator

Location: Cardiff (Fully Site-Based)
Hours: Monday to Friday
Salary: £27,000 per annum

Are you an organised and detail-oriented administrator with experience in accounts and finance processes? We are currently recruiting for an Accounts Administrator to join a well-established business based in Cardiff.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous accounts administration experience to become part of a supportive and friendly team. The role offers exposure to a variety of responsibilities across purchase ledger, invoicing, reconciliations, and general office administration, making it ideal for someone looking to develop their career within a busy finance environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing purchase invoices accurately and in a timely manner
- Matching, checking and coding invoices
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving account queries
- Assisting with payment runs and maintaining supplier records
- Raising sales invoices and supporting customer account administration
- Completing bank and supplier account reconciliations
- Updating and maintaining finance systems and company records
- Providing administrative support to the finance department
- Liaising with suppliers, customers, and internal departments regarding account queries
- Assisting with month-end processes and general finance administration
- Supporting the wider team with ad hoc administrative duties as required

About You
- Previous experience in an Accounts Administrator, Accounts Assistant, Finance Administrator, Purchase Ledger, or similar role
- Good understanding of invoice processing, reconciliations, and general accounts procedures
- Strong attention to detail and high levels of accuracy
- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Experience using finance or ERP systems would be advantageous
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills
- Strong communication skills with a professional and proactive approach
- AAT studies or qualifications would be beneficial but are not essential

What's in it for You?
- Ongoing training and development opportunities
- Career progression within a growing business
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Regular company social events
- Employee discounts and benefits scheme

If you are an experienced Accounts Administrator looking to join a welcoming organisation where your contribution is valued and development is encouraged, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Accounts Assistant (Purchase Ledger)
description:
As an Accounts Assistant in Cardiff, you'll support the smooth running of the accounting and finance operations for a retail business. Your role will involve managing financial transactions, ensuring accuracy, and assisting in essential reporting tasks.

Client Details

Our client is a highly successful and customer-focused business operating within the automotive sector, recognised for delivering premium products and exceptional service standards. With a strong reputation, continued growth, and a commitment to employee development, they offer a professional and supportive working environment where individuals are encouraged to develop their skills and build long-term careers. The business prides itself on teamwork, excellence, and maintaining the highest standards across all areas of its operations.

Description

About the Role

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Accounts Assistant to join a busy and successful finance team within a well-established automotive retail business in Cardiff.

This role will have a strong emphasis on the Purchase Ledger function and will suit someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, has excellent attention to detail and takes pride in maintaining accurate financial records.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing high volumes of supplier invoices accurately and efficiently
- Matching invoices to purchase orders and goods received notes
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving discrepancies
- Managing supplier queries via telephone and email
- Preparing payment runs in line with business deadlines
- Maintaining accurate supplier account records
- Assisting with month-end processes and ledger reconciliations
- Supporting the wider finance team with ad hoc accounting duties
- Ensuring compliance with internal financial controls and procedures
- Building strong relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders

Profile

A successful Accounts Assistant should have:
- Experience in accounting or finance roles within a similar environment.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
- A keen eye for detail and accuracy in financial tasks.
- A basic understanding of financial regulations and reporting standards.

Job Offer
- A salary of 27,000
- A permanent in South Cardiff (Near Penarth)
- Opportunities to develop your skills in a professional finance setting.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

Location: Cardiff City Centre, South Wales
Salary: £30,000 - £35,000

A fantastic opportunity for a Credit Controller in Cardiff!

Are you an experienced Credit Controller with a background in the Lloyd's or London Insurance Market? Looking for your next opportunity in Cardiff?

We are working with an established business based in Cardiff City Centre who are looking to recruit a Credit Controller with specialist London Market experience.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong understanding of insurance credit control, broker collections and claims cash allocation to bring their expertise into a key finance role.

The successful candidate will have previous experience within the Lloyd's or London Insurance Market, ideally having worked for an insurer or MGA, and will be confident managing broker accounts, allocating claims cash and working with multi-currency ledgers.

Key responsibilities:
- Managing broker collections and chasing outstanding balances.
- Overseeing claims cash allocation and ensuring payments are accurately reconciled.
- Managing multi-currency accounts and resolving discrepancies.
- Monitoring aged debt and maintaining effective credit control procedures.
- Liaising with brokers, insurers and internal teams to resolve account queries.
- Working with London Market systems and processes to ensure accurate financial records.

What experience do you need?

We are particularly interested in candidates with:
- Previous Lloyd's of London Market experience.
- ECF (Electronic Claims File) experience.
- Strong experience in broker collections.
- Hands-on claims cash allocation experience.
- Familiarity with DXC / Xchanging systems.
- Experience managing multi-currency accounts.
- A background working for a London Market insurer or MGA.

The package:
- £30,000 - £35,000 salary.
- Cardiff City Centre location.
- Opportunity to join an established business in a specialist insurance finance role.

Interested?

If you're based in Cardiff or the surrounding South Wales area and have the relevant London Market credit control experience, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today for a confidential discussion about this opportunity.

description:
